{{Top|leg}}
'''Zakuulan wine''' was a type of expensive wine produced on the [[Eternal Empire]] capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Zakuul]]. 400 bottles of Zakuulan wine were ordered for the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Zakuulan wine is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during '''"Chapter VI: The Dragon's Maw"'''.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1stm}}
